restaurant.noLocation: You do not see any location yet. Ask an administrator to give you access to one.
restaurant.noCompany: You do not see any company yet. Ask an administrator to give you access to one.

floor.title: Floor plan
floor.description: Set up the areas and tables of a location, place them on the plan and set a table's status by hand.
floor.archiveAreaAsk: Archive the area {{name}}? Its tables stay in your records and no longer show on the plan.
floor.archiveTableAsk: Archive the table {{name}}? It no longer shows on the plan and cannot receive new orders.
floor.gridRange: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to 99.
floor.gridHelp: Position and size are in cells of a 100 by 100 grid over the plan of {{location}}.
floor.noTables: This area has no tables yet. Add the first one.
floor.noAreas: This location has no areas yet. Add an area, then add its tables.

stations.title: Stations and routing
stations.description: Stations prepare what is sent from the till. Route item categories to a station; other items go to the default station.
stations.archiveAsk: Archive the station {{name}}? Items routed to it go to the default station.
stations.printerHelp: The printer the till sends this station's tickets to.
stations.isDefault: Default station for items without a routed category
stations.categoriesHelp: A category is routed to one station per location.
stations.empty: This location has no stations yet. Add a station to start routing.

modifiers.title: Modifier groups
modifiers.description: Groups of choices a guest makes on an item, such as cooking or extras, with the price each choice adds.
modifiers.archiveAsk: Archive the group {{name}}? It no longer shows on the till.
modifiers.rangeInvalid: The most choices must be at least 1 and not less than the fewest.
modifiers.noChoices: No choices yet. Add the first choice.
modifiers.empty: No modifier groups yet. Add the first group.

settings.title: Restaurant settings
settings.description: The service charge, the items that carry it and the tip, and the tip amounts the till offers.
settings.serviceAndTipsHelp: Applies to every sale of this company that comes from an order.
settings.serviceChargeHelp: From 0 to 30 percent of the net amount of the order.
settings.serviceItemHelp: A non-stock item. Its tax category decides whether the charge is taxed.
settings.tipItemHelp: A non-stock item. A tip is never taxed.
settings.tipPresetsInvalid: Enter percentages from 1 to 100 separated by commas.
settings.percentTooHigh: The service charge cannot be more than 30 percent.
settings.readOnly: You can read these settings but not change them.

kds.title: Kitchen display
kds.noStation: This location has no stations. Add one under Stations.
kds.feedFailed: The display could not refresh. It will try again in a few seconds.

orders.title: Orders and tabs
orders.description: Open tables and bar tabs of a location. Open an order to see its lines, tickets and bill.
orders.noTickets: No tickets have been sent for this order.
orders.noSettlements: Nothing has been paid on this order.
orders.mergeHelp: Every live line moves to the order you choose, and this order is closed as merged.
orders.voidSentNote: This line was already sent. The station is told and the void is audited.
orders.cancelAsk: Cancel this order? Only an order with nothing sent or paid can be cancelled.
orders.splitHelp: A preview of the parts. The till rings each part as its own sale.
orders.equalShare: An equal share of every line

errors.voidNotPermitted: You are not allowed to void a sent line. Ask a manager to approve it.
errors.voidLimitExceeded: This line is worth more than your limit. Ask a manager to approve it.
errors.overrideRequired: A manager's approval is needed to void this line.
errors.orderClosed: This order is already closed. Refresh the list and try again.
errors.waiterUnknown: That waiter is not at this location. Choose another waiter.
errors.lineChanged: The line changed since it was sent. Refresh the order and try again.
errors.splitInvalid: These split settings do not add up. Change them and show the parts again.

reports.title: Restaurant reports
reports.description: Guests, orders, sales and tips for a period, and what was voided after it was sent.
reports.noVoids: Nothing was voided after it was sent.
reports.voidsHelp: Lines removed after they were sent to a station.

pending.title: Voids waiting for approval
pending.description: Items removed after they were sent to a station, asked for at a till that the server could not verify. They stay on the bill until you apply them.
pending.empty: No voids are waiting for approval.
pending.applyAsk: Remove {{qty}} × {{name}} from the bill and tell the station? Reason given: {{reason}}.
pending.rejectAsk: Keep {{qty}} × {{name}} on the bill? The request is closed.
